 The Atlanta Hawks host the Brooklyn Nets on Saturday, November 7, 2026, at 7:30 PM ET at State Farm Arena for Divine 9 Night. Celebrate Greek unity with the Divine 9 fraternities and sororities during an evening of Hawks basketball in Atlanta.
 The Divine 9 Ticket Pack includes a game ticket, an exclusive limited-edition Divine 9 pin, and a Hawks belt bag. Purchase through the designated Divine 9 special-ticket offer to receive the package items as they are not included with a standard game ticket.
